A blueprint: pages, an API and files that belong together

Source: R/blueprint.R
spigot_blueprint.Rd

A blueprint groups the pages of one part of an app with the API endpoints, templates, partials and static files they use. spigot_app() mounts it under a prefix: spigot_app(blueprints = list("/cars" = cars)) serves its page / at /cars and its page /model at /cars/model. Define blueprints in the app's R/ directory, which Shiny loads before app.R.

Usage

spigot_blueprint(
  pages,
  api = NULL,
  templates = NULL,
  partials = NULL,
  static = NULL
)

Arguments

pages

One page, served at the prefix, or a named list of pages keyed by path below it, such as list("/" = list_page, "/model" = model_page).

api

NULL, the path of a plumber file, or a plumber router. A file is read with spigot_api() in the environment spigot_blueprint() is called from.

templates

Directories or files searched for the blueprint's template files, before the app's. See templates in spigot_app().

partials

A directory or a named list of partials, as in spigot_app().

static

A directory, served at <prefix>/static.

Value

An object of class spigot_blueprint, for the blueprints argument of spigot_app().

Details

Its API is mounted under the app's API prefix: with the default prefix, the blueprint's /fit endpoint is /api/cars/fit, which a page calls with spigot.get("cars/fit"). The app's session and origin checks apply to it.

Its template files are looked up in templates first, then on the app's search path. Its partials win over the app's, and a page's own over both. Its static directory is served at <prefix>/static, and every blueprint page gets that path, relative to the app root, as {{static}} in its data ("cars/static"), so <script src="{{static}}/cars.js"> works on any of its pages. A static key in a page's own data wins.

Paths are relative to the app's root and are read when spigot_app() builds the app, as template files are.

Examples

cars <- spigot_blueprint(
  pages = list("/" = spigot_page("list.html"), "/model" = spigot_page("model.html")),
  api = "api/cars.R",
  templates = "templates/cars",
  static = "static/cars"
)
cars
#> <spigot_blueprint>
#>   pages:     /, /model
#>   api:       api/cars.R
#>   templates: templates/cars
#>   static:    static/cars
